human_tolerance.notes: Authored judgement: the bird uses wooded countryside and tree fruit, so it can use well-wooded gardens where mature fruiting trees and cavity sites are present.

phases.name: breeding
phases.note: A broad species account gives a December to July breeding period, while Periyar Tiger Reserve observations give December to May. This country-wide window follows the broader account; local timing varies and the schema cannot encode finer regional seasons here.

vocalizations.description: A repetitive, loud kot-roo call, especially frequent during breeding.

conservation.note: Wikipedia reports IUCN Least Concern; its cited assessment is 2016.

range.note: Southern India: Western Ghats and parts of the southern Eastern Ghats. Country-level scope is India.

traits.limb_count.note: Bird schema convention counts the two walking legs and excludes wings.

traits.locomotion_modes.note: Powered flight is shown by its winged bird body plan; flight is retained as the only explicitly modelled locomotion mode.

traits.size_class.note: Small because the AVONET species mean adult mass is below 1 kg.

traits.mass_kg.note: AVONET1_BirdLife.xlsx, Psilopogon viridis row: Mass 80.5 g, Dunning reference; 5 measured individuals. Converted to kg by dividing by 1000.

traits.length_m.note: Midpoint of the reported 16.5-18.5 cm body length range: 17.5 cm, converted to metres.

traits.diet.note: Authored allocation, not measured proportions: fruit dominates because AVONET classifies the trophic niche as frugivore; 0.10 invertebrate reflects opportunistic insects and 0.05 nectar reflects flower visits. Shares sum to 1.

traits.social.note: Authored group-size range for a pair-bonded species; pairs are directly described, larger foraging aggregations are not encoded.

traits.activity_pattern.note: Diurnal; the article reports disputed observations of occasional breeding-season night calls but says other observers consider it strictly diurnal.

traits.defense.note: Flee is a simulation judgement; the source describes aggressive displacement of other birds during feeding, not a documented predator response.

traits.wariness.note: Authored judgement; the cited evidence describes birds in woodland and gardens but does not quantify response to people.

habitat.use.note: Authored time allocation (95% arboreal, 5% ground) to encode tree feeding and rare ground visits.

habitat.shelter_tag.note: Tree cavities are used for nesting and roosting.

habitat.resources.note: Fruit, insects and nectar follow the diet evidence; cavity and perch entries encode tree nesting and arboreal resting. Weights are authored relative importance, not measured diet shares.

habitat.human_tolerance.note: Authored adapter classification for wooded gardens with mature fruiting and cavity-bearing trees; urban tolerance is not quantified by the source.

seasonal.strategy.note: AVONET classifies this species as sedentary; encoded as active year round.

seasonal.phases.note: A broad account gives breeding from December to July; a Periyar Tiger Reserve account gives December to May, showing local timing variation. The country-wide schema field follows the broad period, and the simulation cannot represent finer locality-specific dates here.

seasonal.life_stages.note: Egg, juvenile and adult stages are directly described; juvenile duration is omitted because fledging age is not the full juvenile period.

behavior.note: Species-local program models arboreal fruit feeding, tree perching, daytime activity, breeding-season calls and cavity nesting. Parameter and action timing are authored; the simulation has no explicit biological feeding-rate or tree-crown state.

vocalizations.song.note: The article describes a repetitive kot-roo song, loud and constant in breeding months. Months follow the broad December-July breeding period; local season differences are not encoded. Call frequency is omitted.

vocalizations.alarm.note: The article describes harsh calls during aggressive encounters; call frequency is omitted.

look.note: Green plumage, brownish white-streaked head, pale bill and white cheek stripe are sourced; box proportions and palette values are authored visual approximations.
